about.title: About me
paragraphs: I am a software engineer and technical lead based in Luxembourg. At the Luxembourg Institute of Health I lead the design and delivery of web applications, from sample traceability to data management and interoperability.
My work covers the whole stack: architecting Angular front ends, building Quarkus REST microservices, modelling SQL Server databases and automating delivery with Docker, Jenkins and OpenShift.
I care about reusable solutions, code quality and sharing what I know, through coaching colleagues and through my open-source Angular Material library, Easy Mat UI.

mfe.title: Micro Frontend Architecture
mfe.intro: I design and implement Angular Micro Frontend platforms: a host shell composes independently built applications at runtime, so each one can evolve and ship on its own while users get a single, seamless product.

diagram.pipeline: CI/CD · selective builds, one pipeline per application
diagram.label: Architecture overview: a host shell loads independent remote applications that share libraries, Keycloak authentication and CI/CD pipelines

pillars.title: Angular Micro Frontends
pillars.text: A host application loads remote Angular applications at runtime. Each remote owns its domain, its routes and its release cycle.

pillars.title: Native Federation
pillars.text: Runtime composition built on web standards (ES modules and import maps), independent of the bundler, to share code between host and remotes.

pillars.title: Independent deployment
pillars.text: Each frontend is built, versioned and deployed on its own, so shipping one feature never means redeploying the whole platform.

pillars.title: Shared libraries & components
pillars.text: Common libraries and reusable components keep the UX consistent and prevent duplicated code across applications.

pillars.title: Host ↔ remote communication
pillars.text: Clear contracts between the shell and its remotes keep applications decoupled while they still share the context they need.

pillars.title: Centralized authentication
pillars.text: Single sign-on with Keycloak and consistent role and permission checks across every application, backed by secured Quarkus APIs.

pillars.title: Scalable & maintainable
pillars.text: Clear boundaries between applications, multi-tenant support and reusable building blocks keep large front ends manageable as they grow.

pillars.title: CI/CD & selective builds
pillars.text: Jenkins pipelines build and deploy only the applications that changed, as Docker images on OpenShift.

easymat.title: Easy Mat UI
easymat.creator: Created & maintained by Redouane Chaibi
easymat.intro: A reusable Angular Material component library that turns the screens you rebuild in every project into configuration. Describe a data table once, with its columns, filters, pagination and edit dialog, and Easy Mat UI renders it.
features: Configurable and reusable Angular Material tables
Editable cells and a create / edit / view dialog
